programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This investigation focuses on some friends of Brian's whose home is a deconsecrated 19th century church. They claim to have seen apparitions and to have heard strange noises. Also, one of the doors in the house opens by itself. The investigation turns up only orbs caused by dust. Jason determines that the sounds and orbs are caused by the settling of the wood beams when the church bell rings. The team is able to duplicate the opening door, giving a mundane explanation.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to investigate an armory in New Bedford, Mass. In one room, the thermal imaging camera detects a warm mist passing in front of the lens. This is very strange, because mists are generally colder than the surrounding air. While moving along a catwalk, sound man Frank DeAngelis suddenly falls down and does not feel well enough to move for quite some time.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Reports of disturbances in a college student group house are easily explained as acoustics and encounters with neighbors who were drunk at the time. At the Topton House Pub, witnesses have reported that the ghost of a little girl sometimes trips people on the steps and has moved glasses of soda on one table. The daughter of the owner has also smelled roses while in the cellar and heard murmurring voices.
programme.sub-title: Fortuna Apartment, Topton House, & Frank's Interview / Fortuna & Topton

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Mike Sinclair, the founder of O.R.I.O.N. Paranormal and a TAPS family member, has called in TAPS to co-investigate the New Boston Inn, in the Berkshires. After examining his findings, the TAPS team is able to disprove or cast doubt upon, everything he found. However, the experience their own incident when a pen seems to have moved with no one else nearby. Next they travel to Pittsburgh to investigate the home of Gloria and Genny.
programme.sub-title: New Boston Inn & Gloria's House / New Boston Inn

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS investigates two cases. First they go to Albany, NY to the home of Linda Johnson. Linda claims to be psychically sensitive, and to have been accosted by a negative or ""demonic"" entity. No conclusive evidence is found, but Jason suggests that Keith Johnson contact her separately to try to help further. Next, they meet Adam Zubrowski, who seems to be experiencing strange events. The house was built by his grandparents, and his grandfather died there.
programme.sub-title: Johnson House & Zubrowski House / The Negative Entity

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to New Orleans to investigate one of the "most haunted" places in the U.S., and Brian's new relationship interferes with his work causing tension with TAPS members. They capture an image on their thermal camera and discover a lamp that moves on its own. Jason and Grant both agree that the plantation is haunted.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS helps a family whose young children claim to be tormented by ghosts. They find bones under the floorboards. After further analysis, the bones are not human but animal and the footage shows that the little boy, not ghosts, is waking up his sister in the middle of the night. Then TAPS helps a young woman who is experiencing lots of paranormal activity in her home. Jason is attacked and TAPS concludes that the entity is focused on the young woman.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to New Orleans for a case with a jealous female spirit who won't leave the male homeowner alone. They find evidence that supports the victim's claims when they viewfootage of a door that opens and shuts on its own. While in town, they go to Brennan's restaurant for a meal and some ghost hunting. But their EVPs are tainted by noises that are coming from a private party.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian can't go on this road trip. A training mission in North Carolina goes awry when team members get food poisoning. A local ghost hunting group asks TAPS for help with a haunted battleship. Jason and Grant are chased through the bowels of the ship. There are a lot of personal experiences but the team fails to capture anything on tape. The results are inconclusive.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian asks Jason and Grant for some time off. TAPS visits a local playhouse with a long history of hauntings but their investigation doesn't yield any evidence. Then they head over to a firehouse where the paranormal activity is spooking some of the volunteer firemen. Jason and Grant have an odd experience with a stereo that turns itself on. Andy tries to debunk some alarms that get tripped on their own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Brian leaves TAPS. Andy persuades Jason and Grant to investigate a haunted lighthouse. Steve and Andy experience a cold spot but nothing else happens. Jason and Grant tell Andy he should be more diligent with his case studies. TAPS travel to New York for a haunted museum. Andy gets in a tiff with the other members. The team doesn't capture any evidence of a haunting.
programme.sub-title: New London Lighthouse & Merchant's House Museum

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Steve gets promoted to Tech Manager. TAPS takes on a case that has a personal connection for Kristyn, one of their members. A little boy claims he is being attacked by an entity while his mother suffers dizzy spells whenever she's in the basement. The team discovers high EMF readings and concludes this could be the cause of the dizzy spells since there carbon monoxide leaks weren't detected.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS searches for paranormal evidence at a lavish historical estate in Rhode Island. They debunk the cold spots in the basement when they find a blocked heating system. They do not find any evidence of a haunting. A young and inexperienced paranormal group in New Jersey contacts TAPS for help because they are out of their league. The victim is so frightened she won't allow herself to be seen on camera. TAPS captures recorded sounds of footsteps in her home just as she had reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS welcomes an investigator in training, Dave Tango, from the NJ group. The team goes to a home in New Hampshire where the teenage boys are so afraid of the paranormal activity that they want to move. Grant gets attacked by a drum. TAPS heads the upstate NY to investigate a former insane asylum. They gather no evidence but run into some dive-bombing bats.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS returns to Philadelphia's Eastern State Penitentiary to track down an apparition; the team investigates a haunted vacation home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to California to investigate two locations at the top of their Most Haunted list. The first stop is the Winchester Mystery House in San Jose where Dave and Donna's inexperience in the tech department starts to annoy Steve. Jason and Grant debunk cold spots. They don't capture any evidence of paranormal activity. At the Queen Mary in Long Beach, the team seems overwhelmed by the size of the ship. Jason, Grant and Steve are able to debunk some of the ghostly activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS goes to Ohio to investigate Mansfield State Penitentiary, the location of The Shawshank Redemption film. Dave and Dustin chase a dark shadow down one of the cell blocks. Jason and Grant hear an unseen visitor running on the walkway above them. The team fails to collect any ghostly evidence. They head to Massachusetts and investigate the former home of the infamous Lizzie Borden who was accused of viciously murdering her father and step-mother with an axe.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS has been called to Arkansas to investigate a haunted hotel. Dustin discovers that Grant's computer bag has mysteriously moved on its own. Jason and Grant capture an apparition, "the holy grail", on their thermal camera. The team is welcomed into a medium's home, the most haunted house in the town. Dustin and Dave check out the spooky hollow down the road but don't find anything paranormal. Grant captures some unusual activity on the thermal cam while recording the medium reading Jason.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Kentucky to investigate one of the most haunted places in the country, Waverly Hills Sanatorium. During the decades the facility served as a tuberculosis hospital, where an estimated 63,000 people died within its walls. Over two nights of extensive investigation, the members of TAPS have a variety of inexplicable encounters and eerie personal experiences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to searches Holliston, Massachusetts to help a family that has a spirit haunting their home. Loud footsteps are frequently heard up and down the staircase, an apparition has appeared in the master bedroom, and a voice has been heard yelling "mommy". Their young daughter is so terrified that she refuses to step foot in the basement and does not feel comfortable anywhere in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Jason's hometown of Canandaigua, in upstate New York, to investigate two reported hauntings. A sinister force seems to be at work in the Leonard household. The homeowners have encountered various unsettling noises and events, including witnessing a full bodied apparition in their infant son's bedroom. Concern turned to panic when the homeowners discovered scratches on the back of their infant son's neck. TAPS arrives to uncover what is plaguing the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS answers an urgent call from a homeowner in Clinton, Massachusetts, who is being plagued by a disturbing spirit. Aided by Mike Dion, a member of the New England Paranormal Group, TAPS explores the home and immediately feels an uncomfortable presence throughout. Events escalate until Grant is knocked to his knees. Donna is visibly horrified by Grant's experience, but pushes on with the investigation to find out what other surprises the night may hold.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A frightened family in Glen Gardner, New Jersey calls TAPS for assistance from a menacing shadowy figure that is haunting their home. Hilary and Sean Hodgman have regularly witnessed mysterious black apparitions moving across their master bedroom. Through their investigation, TAPS encounters a series of bizarre sensations and encounters in the home. The team even captures an audio recording of a voice which is heard saying "we are coming.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Florida to investigate the paranormal activities at the historical St. Augustine Lighthouse. Armed with some new equipment, the TAPS team investigates the numerous accounts of inexplicable voices, noises and apparitions that have been reported for decades. Steve must confront his fear of heights in order to investigate the towering lighthouse, which is one of the tallest in the country. Immediately after setting up, TAPS begins to experience all sorts of paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Roselle Park, New Jersey to investigate an Italian restaurant that is being plagued by a deceased former owner. Current employees believe such incidents as stools being knockedover can be attributed to a former owner, Eda, who died decades earlier in the building. The TAPS team sets out to prove whether or not Eda still lingers on the premises.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS travels to Guthrie, Oklahoma to investigate The Stone Lion Inn, a bed and breakfast experiencing paranormal phenomenon. A man dressed in Victorian attire has repeatedly been witnessed by visitors and employees of the former funeral parlor. During the investigation, a number of disturbing audio recordings are captured, including the chilling voice of a child asking "can you find me?" At one point, during the still of the night, Grant even hears his own name being whispered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The Stanley Hotel, the location that inspired Stephen King's classic novel "The Shining", is the setting for this TAPS investigation. The team travels to Estes Park, Colorado to explore The Stanley Hotel and discover what truth lies behind the fiction of the famous thriller. During the tour, TAPS is presented with stories of apparition sightings, noises of a large party coming from an empty ballroom, and even a horrifying case of apparent possession.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The season begins with the TAPS members traveling to Tombstone, Arizona to investigate the wild spirits of the old west. The group heads to the historic Birdcage Theatre, which in addition to housing performances, also served as a dancehall, saloon and casino after it opened in 1881.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS continue their investigation into the paranormal history of the old west by heading to Bisbee, Arizona to uncover the secrets at The Copper Queen Hotel. Built in 1902, the establishment is brimming with frequent sightings of numerous apparitions. These include a little boy named Billy, who is believed to have drowned in a nearby river. Some of the most startling encounters have taken place in the "Julia Lowell Room" where, long ago, a woman of the same name committed suicide.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Vermont, a terrified family calls upon TAPS for assistance with startling paranormal events that are taking place in their home. Since they began renovating, the Johnsons have repeatedly seen so-called "shadow people" moving through their house. One night while sleeping, Sean Johnson, the patriarch of the home, was attacked by forces that cannot be seen.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In Massachusetts, TAPS explores a Victorian mansion with a bizarre history of unexplained activity. The historic home recently underwent a stage of renovation which seems to have stirred up an abundance of paranormal phenomena. The homeowners have seen a number of apparitions dressed in period clothing throughout the mansion. Mysterious voices and strange noises have also been a common occurrence.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this special episode, TAPS presents investigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the unprecedented live broadcast from The Stanley Hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. Nearly 30 years ago, Stephen King's strange encounters during his stay at the establishment prompted him to write the classic horror novel "The Shining". During their intense investigation, TAPS experiences an incredible amount of paranormal activity in the rooms, halls and in the underbelly of the notorious hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For their first overseas investigation, TAPS travels to Ireland to explore the legendary Leap Castle. Hundreds of years old, the historic grounds are said to be the home to numerous malevolent spirits, but none more frightening than a mysterious entity known as the "Elemental". Witnesses claim that the Elemental is an evil energy created from the castle's bloody past, where it served as a place of torture and brutal murder.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Continuing their investigation in Europe, TAPS explores the mysterious Lisheen Ruins in Ireland. These ancient ruins of a grand yet cursed estate are reportedly home to "fairies", troll-like spirits that live underground and wreak havoc on those who trespass. During an intense investigation, the team sets out to learn the truth behind the legends. What was already an unusual investigation turns to panic as TAPS realize they are being hunted by something from the beyond.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In this terrifying episode, TAPS investigates The Hellfire Caves, an elaborate maze of underground caves in rural England. The caves served as the center for a secret satanic society hundreds of years ago. Politicians and other influential people of the era used the deep caves to escape persecution and keep their religious practices shrouded in the utmost secrecy. Today, the eerie history of the caves has manifested into numerous accounts of startling paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: A local homeowner in need of emergency assistance visits the TAPS office after a series of bizarre incidents threaten the tranquility of her home. Lynn Tedeschi has the sense that something mysterious, and possibly dangerous, is present in her home. Her children are terrified by toys which inexplicably turn on and off. Strange sounds move through the home as if echoing from the distant past. TAPS spends the night to determine if a haunted house is lurking in their own backyard.

programme.title: The Wiggles: The Sound of Halloween
programme.desc: The Wiggles perform spooktacular songs.

programme.title: The Wiggles: The Sound of Halloween
programme.desc: The Wiggles perform spooktacular songs.

programme.title: Sid the Science Kid

programme.title: The Brothers Bloom
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of swindling people are too much for Bloom, and he wants out of the business. His brother, Stephen, convinces him to work on one final hustle, targeting an eccentric East Coast heiress named Penelope. The con game fails to play out as planned when Bloom falls in love with the irresistible woman.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Small Town Crime
programme.desc: When alcoholic ex-cop Mike Kendall finds the body of a young woman, he becomes obsessed with redeeming himself by finding the killer. In the process, he puts himself and his family in danger while hanging out with an assortment of shady characters.

programme.title: A Simple Favor
programme.desc: Stephanie is a widowed single mother who works as a vlogger in Connecticut. Her best friend, Emily, seems to have it all, a successful career, a loving family and a glamorous lifestyle. When Emily mysteriously disappears one day, Stephanie launches her own investigation by digging into her friend's past, finding a few surprises along the way.

programme.title: Arkansas
programme.desc: A series of mistakes leads to a deadly collision between two criminals and a drug kingpin in Arkansas.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: Luke Wright is a two-bit cage fighter, until the day he throws a fixed match. In retaliation, the Russian mob murders his family and destroys his life. Though alone and haunted by grief, Luke springs into action to save a Chinese girl (Catherine Chan) from the same gangsters who killed his family -- and lands in the middle of a high-stakes war. The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: When a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal skills and a gambling problem gets in trouble with the mob, he has one last play and it's all or nothing.

programme.title: Redemption
programme.desc: Joey, an alcoholic war veteran assumes a new identity after returning from a traumatic tour in Afghanistan and becomes a vigilante in a bid to atone for his sins.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: Self-reformed petty criminal Terry Leather (Jason Statham) has become a financially struggling car dealer and settled into a pedestrian London life with his wife and kids, but takes the plunge into big crime when his ex-girlfriend, Martine (Saffron Burrows), turns up with an offer to pull off a lucrative bank heist. After Terry assembles his crew of misfits and begins the operation, he finds that there are other agendas at play, and powerful players who have designs on the vault's contents.

programme.title: Crank
programme.desc: Chev Chelios (Jason Statham), a hit man wanting to go straight, lets his latest target slip away, then he awakes the next morning to a phone call that informs him he has been poisoned and has only an hour to live unless he keeps adrenaline coursing through his body while he searches for an antidote.

programme.title: Crank: High Voltage
programme.desc: After surviving an incredible plunge to near-certain death, Chev Chelios is abducted by Chinese mobsters. Waking up three months later, Chev finds that his nearly indestructible heart has been replaced with a battery-operated device that requires regular jolts of electricity, or it will fail. Chev escapes from his captors, reunites with his lover, Eve, and sets out on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to get his real heart back.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

programme.title: Dog Soldiers
programme.desc: During a routine nighttime training mission in the Scottish Highlands, a small squad of British soldiers expected to rendezvous with a special ops unit instead find a bloody massacre with a sole survivor. The savage attackers of the special ops team return, and the men are rescued by Megan, a zoologist who identifies what hunts them as werewolves. Without transport or communications, the group is forced to retreat to a farmhouse to wait for the full moon to disappear at dawn.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

programme.title: Funny Games
programme.desc: An idyllic lakeside vacation home is terrorized by Paul (Arno Frisch) and Peter (Frank Giering), a pair of deeply disturbed young men. When the fearful Anna (Susanne Lothar) is home alone, the two men drop by for a visit that quickly turns violent and terrifying. Husband Georg (Ulrich Mühe) comes to her rescue, but Paul and Peter take the family hostage and subject them to nightmarish abuse and humiliation. From time to time, Paul talks to the film's audience, making it complicit in the horror.

programme.title: Night of the Demons
programme.desc: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: Nikki (Laura Dern), an actress, takes on a role in a new film, and because her husband (Peter J. Lucas) is very jealous, her co-star Devon (Justin Theroux) gets a warning not to make any romantic overtures -- especially since the characters they play are having an affair. Both actors learn that the project is a remake of an unfinished film in which the stars were murdered.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Perrier's Bounty
programme.desc: A petty crook (Cillian Murphy), his ailing father (Jim Broadbent) and a pretty neighbor go on the run from an Irish mobster's (Brendan Gleeson) goons.

programme.title: The General
programme.desc: One of the most revered comedies of the silent era, this film finds hapless Southern railroad engineer Johnny Gray (Buster Keaton) facing off against Union soldiers during the American Civil War. When Johnny's fiancée, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack), is accidentally taken away while on a train stolen by Northern forces, Gray pursues the soldiers, using various modes of transportation in comic action scenes that highlight Keaton's boundless wit and dexterity.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Blind Horizon
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Arlington Road
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
programme.desc: A fighter vows not to speak until he finds the masked man who killed his father.

programme.title: A Walk in the Woods
programme.desc: Travel writer Bill Bryson (Robert Redford) takes a long-lost old friend (Nick Nolte) for a hike along the Appalachian Trail, which stretches more than 2,000 miles from Georgia to Maine.

programme.title: Take Me Home Tonight
programme.desc: Recent MIT grad Matt Franklin (Topher Grace) should be well on his way to a successful career at a Fortune 500 company, but instead, he rebels against maturity by taking a job at a video store. Matt rethinks his position when his unrequited high-school crush, Tori (Teresa Palmer), walks in and invites him to an end-of-summer party. With the help of his twin sister (Anna Faris) and his best friend (Dan Fogler), Matt hatches a plan to change the course of his life.

programme.title: Animal Factory
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: In order to stop the evil Velasca (Melinda Clarke) from hunting down Gabrielle, Xena must unleash an even more depraved immortal to vanquish her---Callisto (Hudson Leick).

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has 24 hours to prevent a warlord from plundering one village, and the world's biggest giant from destroying another.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: While engaged in a battle of wills with her son, Cupid, Aphrodite (Alexandra Tydings) turns Joxer into a dashing hero tasked with stealing a princess's heart away from her betrothed.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When Meleager, the hero who once saved Gabrielle's village, is condemned for murder, Gabrielle and Xena have only one turn of the sand dial to produce evidence that he is innocent.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: A warrior (Jeremy Callaghan) wants to make his name by killing Xena. He fails, but he succeeds in putting the warrior princess in a blind rage when he kidnaps Gabrielle and sells her to agents of a king.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle chance upon King Ulysses on his way home to Ithaca from Troy, and when they see that Poseidon doesn't want him to get there, they do everything they can to make sure that he does.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena reverts to her old ways to whip a dispirited Athenian army into shape to take on a foe known as the Horde.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: After a shipwreck, Gabrielle is rescued by the cursed ship of Cecrops, where she will have to stay until she dies -- unless Xena can break the curse.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: The baby of Cupid & Psyche, on the loose with Daddy's love-causing bow, complicates Xena's attempt to stop Draco from attacking a temple of Hestian virgins.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When the Furies find out that Xena never avenged the death of her father, they curse her with persecution and madness until she completes her task.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: The exact same day continues to start over and over again and only Xena can unravel the mystery.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: Xena enlists the help of four notorious criminals to steal back the secret to an impenetrable metal that Ares is using to win wars.

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess
programme.desc: When Xena goes to help an old foe in a battle against Caesar, she ends up rescuing Gabrielle from the evil talons of Dahak, the 'One God.'

programme.title: Xena: Warrior Princess

programme.desc: In a Boston airport, a character named Clay, played by Cusack, observes an electronic signal that causes cellphone users to commit acts of violence. Clay and a train driver, played by Jackson, travel through the city to locate Clay's family while avoiding the violent individuals.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Astronauts Payton (Dennis Quaid) and Bower (Ben Foster) awake in a hypersleep chamber with no memory of who they are or what their mission might be. While Payton stays behind to monitor the radio transmitter, Bower ventures out of the chamber into the seemingly abandoned spaceship. The men quickly realize that they are not alone and that the fate of mankind hinges on what they do next.

programme.title: American Psycho
programme.desc: In New York City in 1987, a handsome, young urban professional, Patrick Bateman (Christian Bale), lives a second life as a gruesome serial killer by night. The cast is filled by the detective (Willem Dafoe), the fiancé (Reese Witherspoon), the mistress (Samantha Mathis), the coworker (Jared Leto), and the secretary (Chloë Sevigny). This is a biting, wry comedy examining the elements that make a man a monster.

programme.title: Planet Terror
programme.desc: An ordinary evening in a small Texas town becomes a grisly nightmare when a horde of flesh-eating zombies goes on the prowl. Cherry (Rose McGowan), a go-go dancer, and Wray (Freddy Rodriguez), her ex-lover, band together with other survivors in a no-holds barred effort to escape the carnage. The odds become a bit more even when Cherry, who lost her leg to a hungry ghoul, gets a machine-gun appendage and lets the bullets fly.

programme.title: The Blackening
programme.desc: From the director of Ride Along and Barbershop and the co-writer of Girls Trip. We can't all die first.

programme.title: Daybreakers
programme.desc: Ten years after a plague turns most of the world's population into vampires, a critical blood shortage causes panic and gruesome mutations among the reanimated. Edward (Ethan Hawke), a vampire hematologist, tries to develop a blood substitute when he meets Lionel (Willem Dafoe) and Audrey (Claudia Karvan), two fugitive humans who claim to have a possible cure. Edward casts his lot with them in the hope of perfecting the cure before it's too late.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.desc: Johnny's favorite baseball player Bob Uecker talks about his New TV series Mr. Belvedere, collecting baseball cards, and his various commercial endeavors.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Athletes - Pete Sampras (9/14/90)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.desc: Animal trainer Joan Embery introduces Johnny to a wide variety of animals, including a baby gorilla, tiger, cougar and a 13-foot python. Also featured are David Brenner and the Amazing Kreskin.
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (2/20/74)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.desc: Celebrate New Year's day with Foster Brooks, Victor Buono and.....Joan Embery and her gorilla friends.
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (1/1/75)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.desc: Bubble the Hippo makes an appearance (!) with animal trainer Joan Embery. Competing with Bubbles for cutest animal on the show are twin baby orangutans and a horned frog.
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (2/28/78)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.desc: Animal expert Jim Fowler brings out an alligator and crocodile and explains to Johnny the difference between the two. Not to be outdone, Rodney Dangerfield has Johnny in stitches with his non-stop one-liners.
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Jim Fowler (7/23/80)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.desc: If you've ever wondered what an aardvark looks like, this episode is for you. Also featured is comedian David Steinberg, who does a hilarious Ed Sullivan impression.
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Jim Fowler (6/18/81)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show
programme.desc: Animal trainer Jim Fowler brings a baby baboon and golden eagle onto the set, and Johnny's next guest, writer Gore Vidal, exclaims that he should have brought his pet lizard.
programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Jim Fowler (12/15/81)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (6/13/84)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (4/25/86)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.sub-title: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (6/26/86)

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: On 22 June 1941, German pilots were the first to see the sun rise. Before the day was over, the Soviet Air Forces had lost almost 2 000 aircraft. The early German air superiority gave a significant boost to German confidence, and severely damaged Soviet military capability and morale.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: The town of Hotten became very important during WWII as Hitler has ordered it held at all costs because of its key defensive location by the Siegfried Line. An infantry regiment and tanks attack but are stopped by heavy mortar fire. A small squad succeeds by using grenades and .45 submachine guns, allowing the tanks and infantry to take the town after a fierce fight. Stars actor Jim Hutton.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the true story of an American paratrooper rescued by the French underground in Normandy under the noses of German troops. Meet Glen Robinson, a U.S. Captain, underground members, including lovely Lucienne, the Mute himself 'Gabby' Mosely. Nicknamed for his gift of gab, he assumes the identity of a deaf-mute to avoid capture and teams with Lucienne to sabotage enemy communications.

programme.title: Bombers of WWII: Allied & Axis Bombers
programme.desc: Using authentic footage; this program covers the finer details, advantages and shortcomings of the bombers used by the British, Americans and Germans during World War II. Bombers include: The Avro Lancaster, Halifax, Manchester, Short Stirling, Wellington, the B-17 Flying Fortress, B-25 Mitchell, B-24 Liberator, Heinkel He 111, Junkers 88 and Junkers 188, He 177 & the Stuka Ju-87 Dive Bomber.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: The mantle of invisibility surrounding German forces had slipped an fallen since Stalingrad and panzer units suffering heavy loses. A revitalized red army began to payback hitler in a brutal attack as the last months of ww2 passed. Stalin was obsessed with the significance of one town which brought the most terrible end to WW2 in Berlin that anyone could have imagined.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The Battle For Stalingrad

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: There was a plot that eventually Germany, headed east and Japan, heading west, would eventually join up in the Indian subcontinent to make a massive territory. But too many setbacks in 1942 marked the end of the beginning.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler

programme.sub-title: The Rise and Fall of Adolf Hitler: Volume 3 - Why Hitler Lost WWII

programme.title: Anzac Battlefields: The Western Front
programme.desc: The ANZAC's feel the brunt of Germany's Operation Michael, the biggest offensive of World War I.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: General Nenarokov arrives from army HQ with reports of a secret chemical-weapons test site. Allies back an ultimatum on reciprocal chemical warfare but need proof the Wehrmacht will use toxins. Aerial reconnaissance must find the facility and a weak point in the German encirclement.

programme.title: Architects of Darkness
programme.desc: The drug addicted dilettante who created the Luftwaffe. Goering was at Hitler's side from the ill-fated Beer Hall putsch of 1923 until the estrangement between the two in April 1945 when Hitler ordered Goering's arrest.

programme.title: Afghanistan 1979-1989
programme.desc: This project aims to understand the causes of the Afghan war (1979-1989) and its accurate coverage. It started on Dec 12, 1979, when the Politburo members (Leonid Brezhnev, Yuri Andropov, Andrey Gromyko, Dmitry Ustinov) decided to send troops. It was the Soviet Union's first operation outside the Warsaw Pact, becoming their longest and forgotten war.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Rockets and guided missiles are the essential component of any military arsenal. By definition, rockets are unguided and follow the laws of physics and trajectory; whereas missiles are guided, either remotely or internally. There are many different types of missiles, including anti-tank and anti-aircraft missiles, surface to air missiles, and ballistic missiles.

programme.title: Impossible Peace
programme.desc: These are the best of times for the US. Prohibition doesn't stop anyone from having a good time, the country is on wheels or listening to the radio, welcoming the talkies or investing in the stock market with reckless optimism. It's that brief spell they call the Jazz Age, the age of Charles Lindbergh and Babe Ruth.

programme.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Transport Aircraft
programme.desc: Providing exact numbers, specifications, and plenty of facts, Military Aircraft of the 20th Century provides an encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century. This entry focuses on transport aircraft, such as the Junkers JU-52, Douglas DC-3, PBY Catalina, Short Sunderland, and more.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction
programme.desc: The first Marine jet squadron came in November 1947 when VMF-122 fielded the FH Phantom, and later VMF-311 would be the first Marine jet squadron to be used in combat providing close air support. Today, Marine aviation is organized to support the Marine Air-Ground Task Force, as the aviation combat element, providing assault support, electronic warfare, control of aircraft and missiles, and more.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Britain no longer facing Hitler alone, the first GIs arrived in the UK. As Singapore fell, the Allies looked on in horror as Japan also had control of Java, Burma and New Guinea, as they edged ever closer towards Australia.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As Hitler focussed on Russia, the situation in the Pacific developed to epic proportions when the Japanese air force attacked the American Naval Fleet at Pearl Harbour on the 7th of December. This immediately brought the USA into the Theatre of War.

programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle Of The Bulge
programme.desc: On the battle of the Ardennes. British tanks advance; infantry row across a small stream in Holland; machine guns are manned; prisoners are marched to the rear; German citizens greet British troops; German prisoners push a wounded comrade in a cart; civilians are evacuated from Bastogne.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at the campaign in the Solomon Islands directed at the Japanese stronghold on Bougainville. Allied troops eventually secure the beach and slowly fight their way across the island. The Japanese launch a counter-attack, but they are defeated in the Battle of Empress Augusta Bay. After brutal fighting, the island is secured.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: America's Greatest Generals
programme.desc: A profile of General Dwight D. Eisenhower with a bonus program on General Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell.
programme.sub-title: Dwight D. Eisenhower, Joseph 'Vinegar Joe' Stilwell

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: Hill 881 was one of the bloodiest battles of the war. During April-May 1967, two Marine battalions faced a large NVA force intent on destroying the Khe Sanh compound. The Marines stormed and took the hills overlooking Khe Sahn. Included are accounts by Dale Dye (whose films include Platoon, Finding Private Ryan, Band of Brothers) who fought as a Marine in Vietnam.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 2016, over 200 unseen photos of Nazi officials surfaced, revealing the rise of a young Hitlerite group in concentration camps between 1928-1943. Dr. Stefan Hördler spent 5 years analyzing the images, uncovering how these men became perpetrators of horrific crimes. This investigation exposes a little-known chapter of the camps and challenges assumptions about their origins.
programme.sub-title: Unmasking the Killers of the Third Reich

programme.title: Naval Warfare in World War II
programme.desc: After training in Australia and New Zealand, the U.S. Marines land on Guadalcanal. The U.S. Navy suffers defeats by the Japanese Navy around the island-in an area called Ironbottom Sound.

programme.title: Wings at War Collection
programme.desc: For many, the Normandy landings in June 1944 are most associated with the liberation of Europe. But it was almost exactly the year before that parts of mainland Europe began to throw off the Nazi yoke. The defeat of the German and Italian forces in North Africa enabled the Allies to launch their assault on fortress Europe beginning with Sicily. From here, the invasion of Italy was launched.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: In 1939, bombers hit Polish cities, sparking fear and evacuations. By 1940, Britain faced the Blitz, though early German raids targeted airfields. Both Axis and Allies believed air attacks could break morale. The war revealed that bombing had no boundaries-and civilians were on the front lines.

Most projects were halted or destroyed by bombs. This documentary explores lesser-known Third Reich structures, including abandoned tunnels, Flak towers, bunkers, and rare images of Hitler's grand architectural vision.

programme.title: Battle of the Bulge
programme.desc: In June 1944, after the enormous success of the D-Day landings, an end to World War II and Nazi tyranny seemed imminent. But in December 1944 with one last card to play, Adolf Hitler launched the greatest counter offensive in European military history. The world held its breath as Hitler's armies forged forward again to recover ground, forcing the Allies into a Chaotic retreat.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Jungles of Death

programme.desc: In this first film of the series, '1939', follow the prelude to war and consider how the Treaty of Versailles, drawn up after the First World War, failed to keep the peace. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - No Brainer Breakfasts

programme.desc: Ellie visits a busy office where stress has led to junk food snacking and fast-food lunching. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Crazy Schedule Dinner Challenge

programme.desc: He's a meat eater. She's a vegetarian. Their kitchen has become a battleground. Can this marriage be saved? It's Ellie to the rescue with flexible recipes that will bring them together. programme.sub-title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Herbivore VS Carnivore

programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom share their favorite haunts in Los Angeles, including the famous Mel's Diner in Santa Monica. They take a trip to Sonoma County for a farm-to-table adventure and get a rare opportunity to take a fascinating glimpse at the world's most advanced lab-grown meat facility in Oakland.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - California

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom go on a Texas road trip, and absorb the very best of its Southern Hospitality. In Dallas they taste an array of delights offered at the State Fair of Texas. They learn about ranching and how to cook and eat like a real cowboy, and learn the secret behind Austin's best BBQ.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Texas

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.
programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Ciudad Juárez, Pati joins in with a group of Pachuco dancers, who are passionately preserving this distinctive Prohibition-era culture's traditions. Together they head to the iconic Kentucky Bar, rumored to be the birthplace of the margarita. Later, she savors an icon of Juárez's food scene, the burrito, at Burritos El Compa where the Olivares are keeping their family legacy alive.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: For the indigenous Rarámuri people, long-distance running through Chihuahua's majestic Copper Canyon is a way of life. Pati meets the Moreno brothers, who are famous for winning ultramarathons. In Huetosachi, community leader María Monarca teaches Pati about the art of cooking with corn in Rarámuri cuisine, from nixtamalization to a traditional dish known as "chacales."

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Chihuahua's capital, Chihuahua City, Pati meets the first member of the Rarámuri people to become a world-famous pianist, Romeyno Gutiérrez, who teaches her the basics of Rarámuri music before taking her to his favorite barbacoa spot. Pati's also invited into the home of Chef Ana Rosa Beltrán del Río to cook a few ancient Chihuahuan recipes and learn the art of drying chiles.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Symphony of Flavors

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati journeys to Casas Grandes to experience the preserved foods, or "conservas," that sustained people during the Mexican Revolution. She meets a family that has lived for generations at Hacienda de San Diego, Mexico's "White House" for a day after the battle of Casas Grandes, including Diana Acosta and her mother, Sara Ramírez, who still preserves food the way they did during the war.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati saddles up for an exhilarating ride into the heart of Chihuahua's ranch and rodeo life. She gets a lesson in roping and riding from rodeo champion Ricardo "Bubba" Nevárez and his friends, then is invited to a post practice carne asada. She also meets Chihuahua's most influential cattle rancher, Álvaro Bustillos, at his Rancho El Arroyo, where the ranch cook serves up some cowboy delicacies.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In Casas Grandes, Pati rides in style with local art curator Mayte Luján in her 1960s Cadillac. Mayte owns a bed and breakfast, Las Guacamayas, where she invites Pati into the kitchen to make chile con queso in impossibly soft flour tortillas. Later, Pati learns about another tasty export from Chihuahua, pecans, at Gustavo Vázquez's farm, where his family has been growing them for generations.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati visits Mata Ortiz, a village known for its exquisite pottery, and learns its history from local potter Tavo Silveira, who is known worldwide and even made a piece for the pope. Then Pati gets her hands dirty with talented duo Laura Bugarini and Héctor Gallegos, who teach her the basics of Mata Ortiz pottery. Turns out, Tavo can also cook and makes an asado de puerco feast in the town square.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Magic of Mata Ortiz

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: Pati explores the culture of mysterious Mennonites, a religious community who came to Chihuahua from Germany. Mostly, she's after what they're best known for around Mexico, their cheese! She sees their traditional cheese-making process at Pampas Cheese Factory, the holder of the Guinness World Record for largest Mennonite cheese. Then she tries another local culinary innovation, Mennonite pizza.
programme.sub-title: Pati's Mexican Table - Chihuahua's Cheesiest Cheese

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: In one of Chihuahua's most remote areas, Guachochi, Pati shares a traditional Rarámuri meal with community leaders Alejandro Hernández and Margarita González, who advocate for land rights, political representation, and cultural preservation. programme.title: Devil
programme.desc: Five strangers' day begins with an elevator ride in a Philadelphia office tower. But, what happens next is anything but ordinary. The elevator gets stuck, and the trapped passengers, who expected to be together just a few minutes, now face the revelation of their secrets and transgressions. Frightening events turn annoyance into terror, as they begin to realize that one of their number is Lucifer himself.

programme.title: The Visit
programme.desc: Becca and younger brother Tyler say goodbye to their mother as they board a train and head deep into Pennsylvania farm country to meet their maternal grandparents for the first time. Welcomed by Nana and Pop Pop, all seems well until the siblings start to notice increasingly strange behavior from the seemingly charming couple. Once the children discover a shocking secret, they begin to wonder if they'll ever make it home.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: After 10 years of extraterrestrial occupation, residents of Chicago must decide whether to continue to live under alien rule or support the resistance. When young Gabriel Drummond joins the insurgency, he soon finds himself under careful scrutiny from a shadowy figure who's trying to crush the rebellion and its plans for freedom.

programme.title: The Fourth Kind
programme.desc: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler (Milla Jovovich), a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: When the first outbreak of the Reaper virus hit Scotland, Eden Sinclair was one of the last to escape containment and had to leave her mother behind. Twenty-five years later, Maj. Eden Sinclair (Rhona Mitra) leads a team back into the hot zone to find a counteragent to the virus, which has re-emerged in London. She and her comrades wage a desperate battle for survival against feral survivors, as they try to prevent it from ushering in a new dark age.

programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Mysterious events and the discovery of his relative's body lead the residents of Aspern Tallow to believe that Jonathan Lowrie's ghost is at large in their community. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the sleepy village of Martyr Warren, two opposing groups of travellers have set up home. DCI Barnaby and DS Troy are called in to investigate when the local magistrate, principal adversary of the new arrivals in the village, is found shot dead at his home.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby and Troy have to solve a double murder when a feisty former socialite and a Casanova are found bludgeoned to death. However, the motives for the murders seem disparate, and there are several people who are suspected of involvement.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates a death which looks like suicide. The dead man was a troubled and depressed gambler on a losing streak, but Barnaby's nose tells him to look for a murderer and then recognises someone from his past, in the shape of Dr Jane Moore.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby's wife, Joyce, finds a dead body on the Midsomer Florey village green while taking part in a watercolour painting class, recognising it as the elderly Miss Fairfax. Barnaby is given the case, then finds himself taken off it and replaced by a team from the National Intelligence Squad, while he is assigned to deal with a missing handbag.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The death of a young film star at the opening of a 'satanic experience' at his family's ancestral home brings Barnaby and Troy to the feuding villages of Upper and Lower Warden. Here the Smythe-Websters are exploiting the work of celebrated 'House of Satan' author Ellis Bell - but is there more to his legacy?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Julian Shepherd is found drowned, it seems as though he committed suicide due to all his money being tied up in Charles Edmonton's latest invention. When another man dies after poaching peregrine eggs from Charles's wife, Barnaby suspects foul play.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peaceful setting of prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling is rife at the club - along with illegal money-lending and violent assault. Then, as the club considers giving ordinary villagers full membership rights, another golfer is killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby finds a tangled world of crime and intrigue in the art world. A recently discovered masterpiece by local artist Henry Hodgson realises an impressive price at auction just hours before its previous owner is tortured and killed. Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby's secret past as a spy is revealed when a former agent is found dead after a cricket match in Midsomer Parva. While locals blame the brutal killing on the 'beast of Midsomer', Barnaby suspects otherwise. He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peace of Little Worthy is shattered by a bizarre murder when a man is found stabbed and tied down like Gulliver in Lilliput in the sleepy hamlet's model village. Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tearooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A burglar known as 'the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Connie Bishop keeps waking in the night, convinced she has an intruder. Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby is intrigued when he learns that the remains of famous racing driver Duncan Palmer have been discovered at Darnley Park School - 40 years after he was thought to have drowned in the Lake District. During the school's classic car show, racing legend Peter Fossett is annoyed that his fellow judge is club DJ Dave 'Doggy' Day, who knows nothing about cars. Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. Could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema manda a Tijeras y Tostado a cumplir su amenaza contra el hijo de Chacorta. Víctor recibe un disparo en cada pierna. Doña Alba le reclama a Aurelio por el dolor que sufre la familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victor culpa a su padre y su tío de la desgracia que está viviendo, y le dice a Chacorta que ellos solo siembran muerte y destrucción en la familia. Mónica está desconsolada tras perder al bebé.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerra entre bandas del narcotráfico apenas comienza. Aurelio promete venganza: sugiere a Chacorta que trasladen el negocio a España y vigilen a Chema, quien podría escapar de prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pantaleón es secuestrado por Tostado y Tijeras, quienes lo torturan. Aurelio retoma sus negocios con el general Montoya, cambia de planes y viaja a Colombia para comenzar su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Chacorta que mató al Tostado, y aunque vengó a Víctor, aún no ha terminado. Anuncia nuevos negocios con Venezuela y dice que comenzará a llamarse Danilo Ferro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa tiene que ceder para ayudar al Chema a escapar de prisión. Leonor tiene secretos insospechados, y planea usar a Ximena de carnada para atrapar a líderes del narcotráfico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Roberto reclama que los Casillas lo usan para lavar dinero del narco y quiere salirse, pero ya es muy tarde. Leonor y Nevárez visitan al Chema en prisión y lo vinculan con Elsa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con Danilo Ferro y comienza a usar su identidad. Leonor registra el negocio de Matilde y hace que la arresten por todo el material importante que encuentra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa cree tener el camino libre para ser gobernadora, pero Victoria anuncia su candidatura. Bigotes está herido, escapa de los hombres de Chema e intenta darle toda la información a Leonor.

programme.desc: Doña Alba sugiere a Matilde que visite al padre Lázaro en busca de ayuda espiritual, pero ella confiesa que Aurelio está vivo. Tijeras rechaza volver a la cárcel para ayudar a escapar a Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.desc: El padre Lázaro no puede con la presión: quiere hablar con el obispo. Ernesto le pide a Chacorta que le dé un susto. Finalmente, en la casa de Danilo, Victoria y Aurelio se conocen.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres de Chacorta descubren que el padre Lázaro iba a hablar con Garnica, y lo silencian; no dejan cabos sueltos. Por recuperar a su hijo, Matilde está decidida a entregar a Chacorta.

programme.desc: A Matilde le tortura la idea de no volver a ver a su hijo, y el Chema le sugiere que lo secuestre. Leonor desconfía del suicidio del padre Lázaro: le pide a Garnica que presione a los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria y Danilo se besan, y ella no sospecha que se está enamorando de Aurelio Casillas. Ambos confiesan sentirse atraídos el uno por el otro. Mónica confirma su embarazo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica quiere sorprender a Aurelio con su embarazo, pero se lo encuentra en la cama con Victoria. Se hace pasar por su hermana y, a solas, jura no perdonarlo si él se enamora de otra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria sube en las encuestas y eso preocupa a Elsa, quien, en un intento desesperado por ganar votantes, le propone a Max cerrar Villa Catalina. El Chema comienza a interesarse en Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa visita a Victoria y le propone una tregua para trabajar juntas contra el narcotráfico. Max está dispuesto a perder el juicio de Ximena para demostrar con quién está su fidelidad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema ordena la emboscada para recuperar al hijo de Matilde; cuando ella se arrepiente, ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras trata de escapar con sus nietos, doña Alba es brutalmente herida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba es sometida a una cirugía, ha perdido mucha sangre y se debate entre la vida y la muerte. Aurelio sospecha que Matilde y el Chema están detrás. Ximena es condenada a prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio averigua quién es en verdad el escolta de Matilde, y le dice que se despida de su hijo. Los Casillas le declaran la guerra al Chema, y averiguan dónde se esconden sus hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde trata de reconciliarse con Chacorta, pero ya tiene los minutos contados: él no le perdona la traición. Lo importante ahora para los Casillas es hacer pagar al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se enfrenta en la cárcel a otras presas que la provocan, y se descubre que ella es la viuda del Señor de los Cielos. A petición de Rutila, Aurelio acepta reunirse con Santiago.

programme.sub-title: El pene de David; Violador gana lotería

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Prima ALS; La desgracia de la familia

programme.sub-title: Sueldo secreto; Dos pájaros de un tiro

programme.sub-title: Niño asesino; El yogurt de la discordia

programme.desc: A Cándida le roban el auto en el garaje de la tienda donde trabaja y la despiden, ahora demanda a la exjefa. Javier acusa a Naomi de los destrozos en su casa y la aparición de drogas.
programme.sub-title: El costo del viaje; Locura en casa móvil

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lenin ordena desconectar a su mujer con muerte cerebral y se va a EE.UU., pero ella vive para reclamar lo suyo. Carlos construye una familia virtual y le da más valor que a su familia real.
programme.sub-title: Muerte cerebral; Fantasía de play station

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Detienen a Conni por tráfico de marihuana, su esposo puso la droga en su equipaje y ella no lo sabía. Andrea es un transexual que demanda a Eliza, dueña de un hotel, por discriminación.
programme.sub-title: Contrabando de pasto; Intolerancia a los trans

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raymond es cantante, pero no quiere cumplir su contrato con la productora porque en lugar de promover su música lo usan para vender drogas. Lucí­a dice que no en plena boda y estafa al novio.
programme.sub-title: Mafia en el género; Loca por casarme

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Katherine muere en una celda policial sin agua, comida y sin que nadie lo supiera. El hermano de Scarlet busca ayuda en el restaurante de Jean tras ser herido, pero se la niegan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una señora y su acompañante desaparecieron, le reclaman a las hijas que revelen el paradero. Por una cerca que nadie repone, un petardo impacta a una embarazada y le causa un aborto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Steven sale de Colombia, huye de su familia homofóbica y trae dinero de dudosa procedencia. Por otro lado, Alexa desea morirse porque sufre cáncer de médula y la donante es su mamá.
programme.sub-title: Trampa para deportar; Perdidos en locura

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bryan, dueño de una compañía de espectáculos de gente obesa, tiene problemas con dos de sus bailarinas porque bajaron de peso. Lisbeth culpa a su hermana por la desaparición de su hijo.
programme.sub-title: Gordura productora de dinero; Hijo desaparecido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Oslenin paga las consecuencias del comportamiento racista y abusador de su hermano Ricardo. Brayan padece de eyaculación precoz, por eso su esposa lo obliga a usar una dolorosa técnica sexual.
programme.sub-title: No hay peor astilla; El pedalazo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gladis acusa a Juan de ser un monstruo porque siendo veterinario, experimentaba con seres humanos. Además, Javier tiene una empresa que se dedica a organizar matrimonios para moribundos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José no va a su boda y le causa un ataque al padre de la novia, ahora quiere destruir unos óvulos congelados. Adriana se entera de que su hijo murió en un accidente, reclama que le hayan mentido.
programme.sub-title: No me muero, no me caso; Mentira por piedad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Candy ofrece alojamiento a cambio de sexo, pero su inquilino quiere terminar el contrato. Su hija adoptiva busca al padre biológico, al reencontrarse, él la viola, embaraza y asesina.
programme.sub-title: Renta por sexo; Me castigaron con sus vidas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Zuky le exige a Johan 30 mil dólares, él la contrató para un video y le mordió una nalga. Un stripper pide indemnización porque en una despedida de soltera le desgarraron los testículos.
programme.sub-title: La dignidad de la gogosera; Testículos desgarrados

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La hija de Daniel y Ray nació con problemas motores porque el cordón umbilical se enredó en su cuello y le provocó una falta de oxígeno en el cerebro. Ahora la madre la sobreprotege y el padre quiere que haga una vida normal y se prepare para el futuro. Alejandro quiere desalojar a Débora de la casa de su mamá para venderla y darle la mitad a su hermano, quien fue violentamente golpeado cuando se descubrió que tenía una relación con su padrastro.
programme.sub-title: A la escuela sin autorización; Lobitos con piel de oveja

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nally acusa al guardia de seguridad, Osiris, de haber permitido el crimen de su esposo. Indra fue detenida en su cita de inmigración por portar un arma, ella jura que no sabía que la tenía.
programme.sub-title: Miedo a las balas; Negro complot

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Luis se venga de Rosario quien de joven lo violó con un palo de billar, él le hizo lo mismo. Cinthya denuncia a su cuñado y al padre de este por el abuso continuado y muerte de su hermana.
programme.sub-title: Venganza tardía; Sabías que la mataría y callaste

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Víctor ha estado preso y ahora quiere confesar un crimen, pero su esposa se opone, asegura que él es inocente. Nathalie es perseguida por la mafia rusa porque la confunden con su amiga Valery.
programme.sub-title: Terminando con mi vida; Me ha engañado una escort

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Deborah le regala un restaurante a Alejandro y ahora se lo quiere quitar, pero él lo perdió. Además, la hija de Gabriel y Paola es una niña muy delgada, solo come verduras y mira las calorías.
